summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: tslint-folder-schema@1.0.18 declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub release assets, extracts the platform-specific bun binary, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript file shipped in the tarball (array-rotation string-array decoder over a large literal table, hex-mangled identifiers). math_init.js is not referenced from the package's declared main (lib/folderSchemaRule.js); it is reachable only via the preinstall path, and execution is routed through the smuggled Bun runtime rather than Node. The package advertises itself as a TSLint rule wrapper and claims repository/homepage https://github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint, while being published from a personal Gmail account (aegaeon51@gmail.com) with a 151-byte README — an impersonation cover for the install-time payload. A TSLint rule package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to run a hidden opaque blob.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
